resources.string: Auto-handle failed background tasks

When a background command started from a chat or a scheduled task fails, times out or is interrupted, Eta wakes the agent with the task, its exit status and the tail of its output to diagnose and fix it. Success stays quiet; risky actions still wait for your confirmation.
Eta is auto-handling a failed background task: %1$s
Eta is handling a watched background task: %1$s
Waking the agent to find the cause and fix it; you will see the report here.
The job finished as watched; waking the agent to look at the result.
Background task keeps failing, auto-handling stopped: %1$s
Handled automatically %1$d rounds without success, so Eta stopped waking the agent. Check the task log and handle it yourself.
Eta already auto-handled 2 background tasks in the last 10 minutes, so this one was skipped. Check the task log and handle it yourself.
exit code %1$d
ended: %1$s
Background task auto-handled: %1$s
The agent finished this round. Open the conversation to see what it did.
Auto-handling failed: %1$s
This round ended in an error, so nothing is confirmed fixed. Open the conversation to see where it stopped.
Auto-handling timed out: %1$s
This round exceeded the time limit and was cancelled without a conclusion. Check the task log and handle it yourself.
Not auto-handled: %1$s
Eta could not start this round (execution was not allowed, or the loop guard was unavailable). Check the task log and handle it yourself.
Background task wakeup
background command %1$s
Auto-handling: %1$s
A background command finished, so the agent was woken to handle it.
[Background task wakeup] The background command below just finished, and it did not succeed. You are woken automatically to take over.
Tail of the task output:
…(earlier output omitted)

No user is online right now: nothing here is confirmed by a human. Analyse the cause and fix it. Risky actions still go through the approval gate, and an unattended confirmation times out without executing - never report something as done when it was not executed. Report back briefly when you are done. If no action is needed, just say so in one or two sentences. Jobs you start from this run will not wake the agent again.
